CREATE VIEW v_environmental_extremes AS
WITH env_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sitelabel AS plant_name,
    pr.snapts AS event_time,
    ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'dhi_w_m2' AS dhi_w_m2,
    ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'dni_w_m2' AS dni_w_m2,
    ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'ghi_w_m2' AS ghi_w_m2,
    ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'poa_irr_w_m2' AS poa_irr_w_m2,
    ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'uv_index' AS uv_index,
    ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'cloud_cover_pct' AS cloud_cover_pct,
    ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'air_pressure_hpa' AS air_pressure_hpa,
    ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'dust_density_kg_m3' AS dust_density_kg_m3,
    ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'relative_humidity_pct' AS relative_humidity_pct,
    ec.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'cell_temp_c' AS cell_temp_c,
    ec.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'ambient_temp_c' AS ambient_temp_c,
    ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'rain_mm' AS rain_mm,
    ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'wind_speed_m_s' AS wind_speed_m_s,
    ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'snow_cover_pct' AS snow_cover_pct
  FROM environmental_conditions ec
  JOIN plant_record pr ON ec.snapref = pr.snapkey
  JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'Max DHI Irradiance (W/m2)' AS variable, plant_name, CAST(dhi_w_m2 AS numeric) AS value, event_time FROM env_data WHERE dhi_w_m2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Max DNI Irradiance (W/m2)', plant_name, CAST(dni_w_m2 AS numeric), event_time FROM env_data WHERE dni_w_m2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Max GHI Irradiance (W/m2)', plant_name, CAST(ghi_w_m2 AS numeric), event_time FROM env_data WHERE ghi_w_m2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Max UV Index', plant_name, CAST(uv_index AS numeric), event_time FROM env_data WHERE uv_index IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Max Relative Humidity (%)', plant_name, CAST(relative_humidity_pct AS numeric), event_time FROM env_data WHERE relative_humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Max Cell Temperature (C)', plant_name, CAST(cell_temp_c AS numeric), event_time FROM env_data WHERE cell_temp_c IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL

CREATE VIEW v_environmental_extremes AS
WITH env_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sitelabel AS plant_name,
    pr.snapts AS event_time,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'dhi_w_m2' AS numeric) AS dhi_w_m2,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'dni_w_m2' AS numeric) AS dni_w_m2,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'ghi_w_m2' AS numeric) AS ghi_w_m2,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'poa_irr_w_m2' AS numeric) AS poa_irr_w_m2,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'uv_index' AS numeric) AS uv_index,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'cloud_cover_pct' AS numeric) AS cloud_cover_pct,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'air_pressure_hpa' AS numeric) AS air_pressure_hpa,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'dust_density_kg_m3' AS numeric) AS dust_density_kg_m3,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'relative_humidity_pct' AS numeric) AS relative_humidity_pct,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'cell_temp_c' AS numeric) AS cell_temp_c,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'ambient_temp_c' AS numeric) AS ambient_temp_c,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'rain_mm' AS numeric) AS rain_mm,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'wind_speed_m_s' AS numeric) AS wind_speed_m_s,
    CAST(ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'snow_cover_pct' AS numeric) AS snow_cover_pct
  FROM environmental_conditions ec
  JOIN plant_record pr ON ec.snapref = pr.snapkey
  JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
)
SELECT 'Max DHI Irradiance (W/m2)' AS variable, plant_name, dhi_w_m2 AS value, event_time FROM env_data WHERE dhi_w_m2 = (SELECT MAX(dhi_w_m2) FROM env_data WHERE dhi_w_m2 IS NOT NULL)
